In addition to anthropometry, measures using dual energy 
x-ray absorptiometry (DEXA or DXA) and computed tomog-
raphy (CT) scans or magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) scans
have been used to identify and diﬀ erentiate changes in subcu-
taneous and visceral fat stores.105 Additional anthropometric
measures that are speciﬁ c to fat changes seen in chronic HIV 
infection include facial fat measures, dimension measures of 
breast and dorsocervical fat pad areas, and abdominal measures 
to diﬀ erentiate subcutaneous fat gain from potential visceral fat 
gains.106 Losses in subcutaneous fat and/or gains in abdominal
